about: The 26 summonable launch heroines beyond the four founders (10 at 5★, 6 at 4★, 10 at 3★). Stats: "base" is level 1.

petals.text: Rising Floret Cut strikes a third time for 40% ATK
Sword Orchid Ladder also applies 2 Sword Wound stacks for 2 turns
Sword Orchid Ladder can reach mastery +6
Climbing Blooms also adds 10% critical damage per step
Thousand Florets, One Edge can reach mastery +6
Thousand Florets, One Edge strikes nine times, and each critical strike makes the next one 20% stronger instead of 10%

profile.motto: A blade blooms from the bottom up. So do I.
profile.hobby: Sharpening swords that are already sharp
profile.likes: Sword tassels, autumn wind, a worthy duel
profile.dislikes: Dull blades, idle chatter, losing to Ling Shuang

quotes.intro: Shang Jianlan, first sword of Frostpeak, back from the western passes. Who sold my sect while I was away?
quotes.victory: Every floret open. Every foe down.
quotes.ultimate: Thousand florets, one edge!

petals.text: Valley Wind Cut's chance to remove a buff rises from 35% to 60%
Empty Valley Orchid also gives Wind Step to the ally with the lowest Haste
Empty Valley Orchid can reach mastery +6
Accompanying Wind can follow up twice per turn
Gentleman's Verdict can reach mastery +6
Gentleman's Verdict ignores Spirit Shields and Golden Bell, and strikes twice more for 40% ATK if it removed a buff

profile.motto: An orchid in an empty valley is fragrant for no one. That is the point.
profile.hobby: Playing the guqin to an empty room
profile.likes: Guqin strings, old poems, silences that mean something
profile.dislikes: Liars, sweets, being hurried

quotes.intro: Gu Youlan, the Moonshadow Pavilion's sword of the code. Madam Yue lends me to you. Do not make her regret it.
quotes.victory: The wind has nothing more to say.
quotes.ultimate: Hidden fragrance, ten li of wind.

petals.text: Seed-Scatter Slash's chance of Sword Wound rises from 50% to 80%
Pomegranate Skirt Whirl gives her Surging Qi for 1 turn
Pomegranate Skirt Whirl can reach mastery +6
Stacks passed on by Many Seeds gain 1 more stack
Thousand Seeds Burst can reach mastery +6
Thousand Seeds Burst no longer uses up Sword Wound: the stacks burst and stay

profile.motto: Bow before the pomegranate skirt, or bleed before it.
profile.hobby: Challenging anyone who looks strong; eating pomegranates one seed at a time
profile.likes: Candied hawthorns, red silk, loud crowds
profile.dislikes: Poetry recitals, losing, being called little sister

quotes.intro: Zhu Liuhuo, sabre of the Phoenix Palace! Feihong says you're interesting. Prove it.
quotes.victory: Burst open. Like fruit.
quotes.ultimate: A thousand seeds, every one of them burning!

petals.text: Drowsy Cleave has a 30% chance to Body Shatter for 1 turn
Stone Pillow Smash's Body Shatter lasts 3 turns
Stone Pillow Smash can reach mastery +6
Rude Awakening also gives her Iron Body for 1 turn
The Crabapple Wakes can reach mastery +6
The Crabapple Wakes puts the healthiest other enemy into Lotus Dream even without Empower, and its cooldown drops to 4

profile.motto: Wake me when it's worth it.
profile.hobby: Napping on Guild cargo
profile.likes: Lotus seed cakes, soft sachets, sunny crates
profile.dislikes: Spirit tea, early starts, being poked

quotes.intro: Mm... Tang Mian. Guild caravan guard. Is it lunch? No? Then who do I hit?
quotes.victory: Done. Nap time.
quotes.ultimate: I'm... awake... NOW!

petals.text: Magnolia Palm's chance to Provoke rises from 40% to 70%
Golden Bell Shield also removes one debuff from every ally
Golden Bell Shield can reach mastery +6
Bodhi Bell's counterattack applies Qi Disruption for 1 turn
Bodhi Wall of Jade Magnolia can reach mastery +6
Bodhi Wall's shields last until broken, and an ally whose shield breaks gains Iron Body for 1 turn

profile.motto: The gate stands. So do I.
profile.specialty: Golden Bell Shield; temple palm arts
profile.hobby: Embroidery, in secret
profile.likes: Embroidered pouches, sandalwood, a quiet gate at dusk
profile.dislikes: Wine, people who run from a fight, being called stiff

quotes.intro: Jiang Yulan, gate guardian of the Jade Lotus Temple. Stand behind me.
quotes.victory: No one passed.
quotes.ultimate: Jade magnolia, bloom into a wall!

petals.text: Coiling Vine's chance to Entangle rises from 35% to 55%
Violet Canopy also gives Thorn Lotus to the ally with the lowest health
Violet Canopy can reach mastery +6
Clinging Vine reduces damage by 20% instead of 10%
Thousand-Year Embrace can reach mastery +6
Thousand-Year Embrace's Thorn Lotus counterattacks Entangle the attacker, and its cooldown drops to 4

profile.motto: Come here. Closer. Nothing gets through me.
profile.hobby: Hugging people who did not ask to be hugged
profile.likes: Jade hairpins, lotus seed cakes, warm stones in the sun
profile.dislikes: Calligraphy lessons, cold nights, anyone who upsets Lingbo

quotes.intro: Teng Yin of the Serpent Clan. I look after Lingbo, and now, I suppose, you. Hold still.
quotes.victory: There. Everyone's safe in my shade.
quotes.ultimate: A thousand years of vines. Hold on to me!

petals.text: Tea-Mist Palm's chance of Mist Veil rises from 30% to 50%
Winter Camellia Guard also removes one debuff from her
Winter Camellia Guard can reach mastery +6
Falls Whole also gives every ally Clear Heart for 1 turn
Whole-Bloom Fall can reach mastery +6
Whole-Bloom Fall gives Lotus Dew even without Empower, and its cooldown drops to 4

profile.motto: I'll get it right next time. The tea, I mean. The fighting I can do.
profile.hobby: Brewing tea nobody can drink
profile.likes: Spirit tea, lotus seed cakes, the first snow
profile.dislikes: Plum wine, broken teacups, being rushed

quotes.intro: Lin Chaxue, from the Guild's tea house! I can't brew, but I can block. Is that still useful?
quotes.victory: Everyone's fine! Tea? Oh. No. Sorry.
quotes.ultimate: Camellias don't drop their petals. We fall whole!

petals.text: Cuckoo's Cry's chance to Provoke rises from 40% to 60%
Weeping Blood Bloom's Thorn Lotus counterattacks apply Fire Poison for 1 turn
Weeping Blood Bloom can reach mastery +6
Tears Like Fire's chance rises from 25% to 50%
Mountains Ablaze in Red can reach mastery +6
Mountains Ablaze in Red also Provokes every enemy for 1 turn and gives her Thorn Lotus, and its cooldown drops to 4

profile.motto: I cry a lot. I never back down. Both are true.
profile.hobby: Reading tragic poems and sobbing
profile.likes: Candied hawthorns, tragic poetry, mountain azaleas
profile.dislikes: Incense smoke, illusions, lies (she cannot tell one)

quotes.intro: Du Tihong! The only fox in the clan who can't cast an illusion, so I learned to hit things. Hello!
quotes.victory: We won! I'm not crying. Fine, I'm crying.
quotes.ultimate: Hear the cuckoo! The mountains burn red!

petals.text: Imperial Fan Strike's shield rises to 10% of her max Health
Unbowed Before the Empress's Clear Heart lasts 2 turns
Unbowed Before the Empress can reach mastery +6
Wealth and Rank pays 2 Spirit Qi when the hit is a critical hit
Queen of a Hundred Flowers can reach mastery +6
Queen of a Hundred Flowers gives 5 Spirit Qi instead of 3 and readies every ally's S1

profile.motto: An empress once ordered me to bloom. I declined.
profile.specialty: Jade-shield body arts; spending money beautifully
profile.hobby: Being admired; hosting banquets nobody asked for
profile.likes: Jade hairpins, silk fans, an audience
profile.dislikes: Street food, being ignored, anyone wearing purple better

quotes.intro: Wei Zi, heiress of the Myriad Treasures Guild and Queen of a Hundred Flowers. You may feel honoured now.
quotes.victory: Naturally.
quotes.ultimate: Bloom for your queen, and stand behind her!

petals.text: Pear Petal Needles fires five needles instead of four
Rainstorm Pear Blossom Needles has +20% critical chance
Rainstorm Pear Blossom Needles can reach mastery +6
Hidden Weapon Case breaks 2 extra segments instead of 1
A Thousand Trees in One Night can reach mastery +6
A Thousand Trees in One Night fires sixteen needles, and needles meant for a fallen target fly on to the next enemy

profile.motto: Why throw one needle when you can throw three hundred?
profile.hobby: Taking apart things that worked fine
profile.likes: Embroidered pouches (for needles), candied hawthorns, springs and gears
profile.dislikes: Poetry recitals, sitting still, Senior Sister Mo calling her kid

quotes.intro: Li Qianshu, Moonshadow Pavilion! Senior Sister Mo says I talk too much. She's right. Want to see my needle case?
quotes.victory: Overnight, a thousand trees in bloom!
quotes.ultimate: Spring wind comes in one night!

petals.text: Kite-Tail Darts' chance of Mist Veil rises from 25% to 45%
Blue Kite Vanishing also gives her Wind Step for 2 turns
Blue Kite Vanishing can reach mastery +6
Unseen Courier's Shadow Veil lasts 2 turns and returns at the start of each wave
Rainbow Messenger can reach mastery +6
Rainbow Messenger brings every ally's S2 1 turn closer even without Empower, and its cooldown drops to 4

profile.motto: The letter arrives. Nobody sees who brought it.
profile.specialty: Mist steps; delivering what should not be read
profile.hobby: Reading the letters she delivers (she reseals them perfectly)
profile.likes: Poetry anthologies, calligraphy, rainy mornings
profile.dislikes: Plum wine, loud rooms, being noticed

quotes.intro: ...Oh! You saw me. Lan Yuan, Tianji Pavilion courier. I have a letter for you. It's from me.
quotes.victory: Delivered.
quotes.ultimate: Through the mist, past the rainbow!

petals.text: Thorned Kiss's chance of Heart Demon rises from 25% to 40%
Fox-Fire Rose's Thorn Lotus counterattacks add a Heart Demon stack
Fox-Fire Rose can reach mastery +6
Nine-Tailed Allure also gives the team 2 Spirit Qi
Rose of the Crimson Moon can reach mastery +6
An enemy charmed after Rose of the Crimson Moon attacks its allies with its strongest ready technique instead of a basic attack

profile.motto: Admire me from a distance. Closer costs extra.
profile.hobby: Collecting broken hearts and jade hairpins
profile.likes: Jade hairpins, plum wine, being the loveliest in the room
profile.dislikes: Spirit tea, plain clothes, Wei Zi

quotes.intro: Hu Qiangwei of the Fox Clan. Yes, the beautiful one. Mind the thorns, darling.
quotes.victory: Every rose leaves a mark.
quotes.ultimate: Bloom red under the crimson moon!

petals.text: Bamboo-Leaf Fang's chance of Gu Venom rises from 40% to 70%
Sweet Oleander Mist always applies Withering, for 2 turns
Sweet Oleander Mist can reach mastery +6
Poison Without Order caps at +60%, and a chain break at the cap gives the team 1 Spirit Qi once per turn
Every Petal a Poison can reach mastery +6
Every Petal a Poison strikes every enemy carrying Gu Venom, not only its target

profile.motto: Order is only a poison that hasn't worked yet.
profile.specialty: Venoms, and antidotes she refuses to share
profile.hobby: Brewing tea that may or may not be safe
profile.likes: Spirit tea, silk fans, chaos at banquets
profile.dislikes: Calligraphy, schedules, Ju Yannian's antidotes

quotes.intro: She Qingzhu, Serpent Clan. Pretty flowers, poisonous leaves. Do sit down, the tea is mostly fine.
quotes.victory: Oh dear. Was that too much?
quotes.ultimate: Every petal, a poison!

petals.text: White Jasmine Seal's chance of Karmic Mark rises from 30% to 50%
Scripture of Silence also delays the target's charging techniques by 1 turn
Scripture of Silence can reach mastery +6
Song of the Jasmine also gives her +10% damage for the turn
Fragrance Fills the Garden can reach mastery +6
Fragrance Fills the Garden applies Body Shatter even without Empower, and its cooldown drops to 4

profile.motto: Write it neatly, and even fate has to read it.
profile.hobby: Humming the jasmine song while copying records
profile.likes: Calligraphy scrolls, jasmine tea, fresh ink
profile.dislikes: Candied hawthorns (sticky fingers), smudges, interruptions

quotes.intro: Ning Suxin, scribe of the Tianji Pavilion. I will record your deeds. Please make them legible.
quotes.victory: Recorded. Neatly.
quotes.ultimate: Let the fragrance fill the whole garden!

petals.text: Peachwood Charm has a 30% chance to Entangle for 1 turn
Door God's Ward removes two buffs from each enemy
Door God's Ward can reach mastery +6
Ward Against Evil gives +25% effect resistance instead of 15%
Peach Grove Exorcism can reach mastery +6
Peach Grove Exorcism also Soul Shocks Yin enemies for 1 turn, and its cooldown drops to 4

profile.motto: Evil spirits, begone! ...Is it gone? Check behind the door.
profile.hobby: Sticking talismans on doors, on furniture, on the Pavilion Master
profile.likes: Sandalwood incense, candied hawthorns, the Shangsi festival
profile.dislikes: Jade hairpins (she wears peachwood), dark corridors, being mistaken for Tao Yao

quotes.intro: Yu Lei, exorcist of the Jade Lotus Temple! No, I'm not Tao Yao, different peach. Hold still, there's a ghost on you. ...There. Gone.
quotes.victory: Exorcised! Probably!
quotes.ultimate: Peach grove, drive out every evil!

petals.text: Wave-Treading Talisman's chance of Qi Disruption rises from 35% to 55%
Mirror of Still Water also delays the enemy whose ultimate is closest by 1 turn
Mirror of Still Water can reach mastery +6
When Reflection's Kindred Qi reaches +45%, the team gains 1 Spirit Qi, once per turn
Reflection of the Water Immortal can reach mastery +6
The reflection recasts the previous two ally techniques instead of one

profile.motto: Look closely. The water shows you what you are.
profile.hobby: Admiring her reflection, and other people's, politely
profile.likes: Guqin strings, jade hairpins, still ponds
profile.dislikes: Festival wine (white serpents and wine end badly), muddy water, haste

quotes.intro: Bai Lingbo of the Serpent Clan. Grandfather Bai Lin sends his regards. Shall we see what the water thinks of you?
quotes.victory: The ripples settle. So do they.
quotes.ultimate: Rise, my reflection. Tread the waves with me.

petals.text: Morning Sun Talisman's chance of Fire Poison rises from 35% to 60%
Golden Crow Seal also Seals Meridians for 1 turn
Golden Crow Seal can reach mastery +6
First Light also gives every ally Wind Step for 2 turns
Ten Suns over Fusang can reach mastery +6
Ten Suns over Fusang delays enemy techniques by 2 turns and brings allies' S2 2 turns closer

profile.motto: The sun has never once been late. Neither have I.
profile.hobby: Watching every sunrise and reporting on it
profile.likes: Calligraphy scrolls, candied hawthorns, rooftops at dawn
profile.dislikes: Embroidered pouches, curtains, anyone still asleep at sunrise

quotes.intro: Sang Chaoxi, Sun Talisman Saint of the Phoenix Palace! It's dawn somewhere, Pavilion Master. Up!
quotes.victory: And the sun rises on us again.
quotes.ultimate: Ten suns over Fusang! Morning has come!

petals.text: Sorrowless Charm's chance of Lotus Dream rises from 25% to 40%
Forget-Sorrow Talisman's Sealed Meridians lasts 2 turns
Forget-Sorrow Talisman can reach mastery +6
A Mother's Worry also gives that ally Lotus Dew for 2 turns
Mother's Hall can reach mastery +6
Mother's Hall puts the two healthiest enemies into Lotus Dream for 1 turn, even without Empower

profile.motto: Eat something first. Sorrow can wait until after supper.
profile.hobby: Cooking for refugees, for the Pavilion, for anyone who stands still
profile.likes: Lotus seed cakes, embroidered pouches, a full table
profile.dislikes: Sword tassels (weapons make her worry), skipped meals, goodbyes

quotes.intro: Xuan Wangyou, from the Jade Lotus Temple kitchen. Have you eaten? You look like you haven't eaten.
quotes.victory: There, it's over. Forget it, and come have some soup.
quotes.ultimate: Forget your sorrows. Mother's hall is open.

petals.text: Moonsteel Petal ignores 30% of Defense instead of 15%
Wu Gang's Endless Axe grows up to +80%
Wu Gang's Endless Axe can reach mastery +6
Her casts still give Phase Qi, to the phase the chain needs next instead of the phase she feeds
The Cold Palace Descends can reach mastery +6
The Cold Palace Descends falls again at the start of your next turn, hitting every enemy for 60% ATK

profile.motto: The moon has company enough. It has me.
profile.hobby: Drinking osmanthus wine alone; feeding her jade rabbit
profile.likes: Plum wine (osmanthus wine is better), guqin strings, empty cliffs at night
profile.dislikes: Poetry anthologies (every poet writes about the moon; none has visited), crowds, being asked to join in

quotes.intro: Gui Chanjuan. I live on the cliff nearest the moon. You climbed all this way? ...Fine. I'll come down. Once.
quotes.victory: Quiet again.
quotes.ultimate: The cold palace descends.

petals.text: Apricot Rain falls four times instead of three
Thunder Wakes the Insects' chance to Entangle rises from 40% to 60%
Thunder Wakes the Insects can reach mastery +6
Spring Thunder strikes for 50% ATK instead of 30%
Apricot Blossom Village can reach mastery +6
Apricot Blossom Village leaves a spring rain for 2 turns: at the start of your turns every enemy takes three hits of 15% ATK

profile.motto: Spring bustles on the branch. So should you.
profile.hobby: Keeping the tavern at Apricot Blossom Village, where travellers lose their way and their purses
profile.likes: Plum wine, silk fans, festivals that run all night
profile.dislikes: Sandalwood incense, early nights, exorcists

quotes.intro: Wen Xingyu, keeper of the Apricot Blossom Village tavern! The herd boy points the way, darling. First cup's free.
quotes.victory: Rain's over. Drinks are on the Pavilion Master!
quotes.ultimate: Spring thunder! Everyone up and dancing!

petals.text: Snowline Petal's chance to Frost Seal rises from 25% to 40%
Tianshan Blizzard's chance to Frost Seal rises from 25% to 35%
Tianshan Blizzard can reach mastery +6
Cold Purity also heals the most injured ally for 30% ATK
Thousand-Year Snow Lotus can reach mastery +6
Thousand-Year Snow Lotus heals 80% ATK and removes one debuff from every ally

profile.motto: Cold keeps things pure. And fresh.
profile.hobby: Tasting lowland food for the first time, all of it
profile.likes: Lotus seed cakes, candied hawthorns, anything hot
profile.dislikes: Silk fans (why be colder?), lowland summers, being called fragile

quotes.intro: Xue Lianxin, from above the snowline. Elder He Ling says I should see the world. Is the world always this warm?
quotes.victory: Frozen. Preserved. Good.
quotes.ultimate: A thousand years of snow, one bloom.

petals.text: Climbing Stone has a 25% chance of Body Shatter for 1 turn
Pillar to the Clouds' Iron Body lasts 2 turns
Pillar to the Clouds can reach mastery +6
Borrowed Height gives +25% damage instead of 15%
Soaring Over the Empyrean can reach mastery +6
Soaring Over the Empyrean always applies Body Shatter, and its cooldown drops to 4

profile.motto: Today a vine. Tomorrow, the clouds.
profile.hobby: Climbing anything taller than she is, then telling everyone
profile.likes: Jade hairpins, silk fans, the view from the top
profile.dislikes: Homemade gifts, being told to wait her turn, the word fledgling

quotes.intro: Qiao Lingxiao of the Crane Clan! I can't fly yet, so I climb. Someday I'll stand higher than all of them. Starting with you!
quotes.victory: Did you see? From up here you all look tiny!
quotes.ultimate: Soar past the clouds!

petals.text: Eastern Fence Needle heals the two most injured allies
Chrysanthemum Tea removes two debuffs
Chrysanthemum Tea can reach mastery +6
Defying Frost gives +20% critical chance instead of 10%
Double Ninth Longevity can reach mastery +6
Double Ninth Longevity also gives Lotus Dew for 2 turns, and its cooldown drops to 4

profile.motto: Bed by the hour of the boar. No exceptions. Not even for heroes.
profile.hobby: Picking chrysanthemums by the eastern fence; scolding
profile.likes: Spirit tea, Tao Yuanming's poems, an early night
profile.dislikes: Plum wine (think of your liver), late nights, She Qingzhu's tea

quotes.intro: Ju Yannian, Frostpeak's physician. Sit. Tongue out. When did you last sleep? Don't lie to me.
quotes.victory: Everyone drink your tea. All of it.
quotes.ultimate: Double Ninth! A long life to every one of you!

petals.text: Lily Bulb Remedy heals the two most injured allies
Hundred Years in Harmony's Lotus Dew lasts 3 turns
Hundred Years in Harmony can reach mastery +6
Matchmaker's Eye gives +35% healing instead of 20%
Red Thread Bloom can reach mastery +6
Red Thread Bloom also readies the S1 of the most injured ally, and its cooldown drops to 4

profile.motto: Everyone belongs with someone. I just help them notice.
profile.hobby: Keeping a ledger of who likes whom (it is very long)
profile.likes: Embroidered pouches, lotus seed cakes, weddings
profile.dislikes: Sad songs, broken engagements, people who insist they like being alone

quotes.intro: An Baihe, the Guild's matchmaker! A hundred years of harmony, guaranteed. Now, Pavilion Master, about your future...
quotes.victory: See? We work well together. I'm writing that down.
quotes.ultimate: Tie the red thread! Nobody falls alone!

petals.text: Five-Colour Petals heals the two most injured allies
Changing Soil's phase buff lasts 2 turns
Changing Soil can reach mastery +6
Rain-Season Bloom's Lotus Dew lasts 2 turns
Embroidered Ball of Five Colours can reach mastery +6
Embroidered Ball of Five Colours gives Phoenix Rebirth to the two most injured allies, and its cooldown drops to 4

profile.motto: Tell me where I'm planted, and I'll tell you what colour I am.
profile.specialty: Shifting healing arts; reading the soil of a fight
profile.hobby: Embroidery in every colour; trying to pick a favourite
profile.likes: Embroidered pouches, poetry anthologies, rainy-season gardens
profile.dislikes: Sword tassels, being asked her favourite colour, the embroidered-ball incident

quotes.intro: Ying Wucai of the Tianji Pavilion. Today I'm blue, I think. Ask me again after the battle.
quotes.victory: Pink! I'm pink now. We won, so pink.
quotes.ultimate: Five colours, one blossom! Catch!

petals.text: Rouge Strike has a 30% chance of Fire Poison for 2 turns
Quicken the Blood gives Surging Qi to the two allies with the highest Attack
Quicken the Blood can reach mastery +6
A Little Rouge also gives every ally Wind Step for 1 turn
Red Flower Cautery can reach mastery +6
Red Flower Cautery no longer costs health, and it also gives Lotus Dew for 2 turns

profile.motto: A little rouge, a little fire, and you'll live.
profile.hobby: Making rouge from safflowers; doing everyone's makeup before battle
profile.likes: Silk fans, candied hawthorns, a busy infirmary
profile.dislikes: Guqin laments, patients who won't sit still, pale faces

quotes.intro: Fang Yanzhi, Phoenix Palace field medic! Hold still. This will sting, and then you'll be fine. Also, a little rouge.
quotes.victory: Everyone's cheeks are rosy again!
quotes.ultimate: Red flower, burn the hurt away!
